notes.title: The Cabin - Episode 9 | Dev-Note
notes.notes: [p]Hey all,[/p][p]Quick update for you this time, without me rambling too much. All the art and writing is done for episode 9; my priority now is rendering, which is still going to take about another week, so release will be at the end of the month, but it will be this month for sure.[/p][p]And finally, work on Adverse Effects 2 is underway but is kind of slow going. I'm not really in a writing mood at the minute and can't really be bothered doing the brief if I'm being honest. Once I get into a groove with it, it'll be smooth sailing, but right now I'm not feeling it, so my focus is mostly on The Cabin and WTHI. [/p][p]And lastly, I don't normally like to talk about finances, but Steam has taken a massive hit recently; with all the crap that came out with the activist group and payment processors, I'm finally starting to see some impact from it, and it's not good. I'm not going to go into any numbers or anything; I'm just adding this in for any other developers that are feeling the impact too: you're not alone. It's not going to affect the development of the game; even if it gets banned on Steam or whatever, I'll still be developing it, so fear not. [/p]

notes.title: The Cabin - Episode 9 | Dev-Note
notes.notes: [p]Hey all,[/p][p]Just wanted to give a quick update about this last month and what to expect in the coming months.[/p][p]First off, I had high hopes that episode 9 would be out this month; sadly, due to some family issues I'm having to delay it a little. I had some family problems at the start of the month, but that all died down after a week, but then last week it all went to hell again. I won't go into any detail about it, but I'm having to look after my 3 nieces during the day, and ( for obvious reasons ) I can't work on a porn game with them around. I'm still trying to work on The Cabin at night and on the weekends, but with a full-time job, looking after 3 kids and trying to support another family member has just been a massive physical and emotional rollercoaster. That being said, something was said on the situation by one of my family members last week which gives me hope that the emotional aspect of it is over. [/p][p]That being said, progress hasn't come to a total halt; I am still working where I can. It's just a little tricky, but I see a lot of late nights and early starts in my future. That being said, let me give you a little update on episode 9/10.[/p][p]So as for the writing, Crab has finished the writing for the 1st scene of episode 10 and will be starting on the 2nd soon. And for the art, I have 7 scenes complete and have 2 more left to do. Those last 2 scenes aren't anything too tricky; however, the 9th scene will require a lot of new coding that I'm not 100% sure I can do yet. If I can't, I have friends that can walk me through it so it will get done.[/p][p]I also have a few new features I want to add into episode 9, but 1 might require a restart of the game, so I may delay adding that in. I'll let you know once I've done some actual tests.[/p][p]Also, in my last post, I said that I'll be doing monthly dev notes at the end of each month. I've decided to change this to the middle of the month instead, as, like now, if there are any delays, knowing at the end of the month isn't going to help anyone.[/p][p]I still can't say 100% that everything is fine and dandy in my personal life, but I hope to have a release out in September. If you have any questions or concerns, comment them here. And I know this might sound like one of those devs who have a shit tonne of family shit because they can't be bothered with the game anymore and eventually just stop, but let me assure you, as I have in the past, I have zero intention of cancelling the cabin. [/p]

notes.title: The Cabin - Episode 9 | Dev-Note
notes.notes: [p]Hey all,[/p][p][/p][p]I realised it's been a while since I've done an update here, and truth be told, I sort of forgot. I'm going to try to do at least one development update per month from now on. I've added a reminder in my phone to remind me on the last day of the month, every month. There obviously won't be one at the end of this month since I'm posting it now... yeah. But the point of the updates is both to update you guys and to hold myself accountable. I feel like I've been slacking off too much with The Cabin, and things need to change.[/p][p]That being said, massive updates have been made this month from both Crap and myself. First Crab, he's finished all the writing for episode 9 and will soon be starting on the planning phase of episode 10. He already has a decent idea of how it'll go and what'll be involved, but that's all in his head at the moment, and it needs to be fleshed out a little, and we both need to go over it fully to make sure it fits with the overall story. [/p][p]As for the art, I currently have up to scene 5 finished and another 4 scenes left to go. That being said, episode 5 was a big scene and a pain in my ass, but now that that's done, I expect the last 4 scenes will go a lot smoother (although, one other scene is also a big one, but I can't recall which one off the top of my head).[/p][p]I've also run into a slight issue with this episode. A couple of the scenes require animations, and my regular animation guy isn't answering my messages, and I fear he may have gone AWOL. If that's the case, I'll have to either release without animations, look for another animator, or attempt them myself. I've done one of the anims myself, but the others are a little tricky, and I doubt I'd be able to do them. The scenes still flow just fine without animations, but I'd rather have them. Hopefully I hear back from him soon, but if not, I don't know what we're going to do. [/p][p]I'm sure you've all probably heard too, but there is a big uproar going on in the NSFW world in recent weeks with the kickback from payment processes, thanks to a certain activist group. I stand 100% with the developers and the NSFW community and am doing everything I can to help out, though I have to admit, it looks bleak. If you want to help out, there is a petition you can sign that might help; since I can't link it here, simply google "[b]Stop Controlling What We Can Watch, Read, or Play."[/b][/p][p]As some of you already know, The Cabin was removed from itch by itch themselves. I had no notification of this and didn't find out until someone messaged me. I find it a little odd that they removed the cabin but simply delisted all my other games. But what happens if it gets removed from Steam? Honestly, I don't know. There are no other markets like Steam, and losing it would probably be the end of my development career. I wouldn't be able to survive on Patreon alone, so as sad as it might be, losing steam would be the end of The Cabin. From what I know of Steam, they don't give you the option to change any content in your games. I know of a couple of devs who (before this whole NSFW assault started) had their games declined from Steam because of 1 small detail, and Steam didn't give them the option to change it; they simply banned the game from ever being sold. So I don't know if they'll give me the option to change the content, but even if they did, I don't think I would. The Cabin is the way it is because that's the way I wanted it; it's already been censored too much with the whole "landlady" thing, thanks to Patreon, and I wouldn't want to censor it anymore than that.[/p][p]With that all said, maybe we're panicking over nothing and all will be fine. I hope it will be, but I'm a realist, and I honestly think we might be at the start of the end of NSFW games. I hope I'm wrong, but that's all for this month. See you all next month, where I doubt the update will be this long :P[/p][p]P.S - I almost forgot, I don't like giving release dates, but depending on the whole animation situation, I hope to have it out sometime in August. [/p]

notes.title: The Cabin - Episode 8 | Dev-Note
notes.notes:
Bonjour, and welcome to May!

As I said not too long ago, I'll be leaving at the end of this month for a week to go on holiday, so I really want to get episode 8 out before I go. I've had a word with Cheeky, and I've taken this week off from WTHI to focus on getting Episode 8 finished. Having worked on it a very small amount yesterday and ( so far ) an even smaller amount today, I'm very confident I can get it finished in time. I know that might sound weird, being working a little but being confident we'll get it done, but I've had a bit of a family weekend going on the last couple of days, and even though I've only worked a small amount, I still got a shot tonne done! So over the next week, when I have zero commitments anywhere else, I should be good.

I'm not going to go into some super long ramble like I normally do, so I'll give you some quick notes instead:

I have 3 more scenes to do art for. The one that I'm currently working on is the longest, and I'm about 65% done, and then the last 2 scenes aren't massive or super complex, so it shouldn't take ages to do those. I doubt I'll have ALL the art done this week, but so long as I get this scene I'm currently working on done and the 2nd to last one done, then we'll be good for a release this month.

I haven't started writing for the new mini game yet; my focus is 100% on episode 8 right now, so once the episode is out, I'll start writing for the new mini game then ( possibly in June ), or I might not rush into it. I've had some changes in my finances that have stabilised me a little, so I've no rush to get one out. So long as I get one out by November, I'm good – so plenty of time, but I'll probably finish episode 8 and then just dive right into episode 9. Kingcrab has been a massive help with his writing and is really freeing me up to do more work on the art.

This will more than likely be the final dev note before the release, although I do plan on releasing some spicy previews at some point this week, so keep an eye out for those. That being said, this'll probably be the last time you hear from me before the release is out, so I hope you're all having an amazing month, and I'll see you all soon.

notes.title: The Cabin - Episode 8 | Dev-Note
notes.notes:
Hey all,

I wanted to jump on real quick and give a little update for episode 8 and also do a couple of introductions as well and update as to when we might be expecting the release of episode 8.

[b]The Introductions:[/b]

I'd like to introduce you to a couple of people. The first being the lovely lady in the render, Roxy. I ran a poll on Patreon with names suggested there and here, and Roxy was the winner with 39% of the votes. For those interested, there will be a screenshot at the bottom of this post with the full results.

Second, I'd like to introduce you to [b]Kingcrab[/b]. If you're in the Discord group, I'm sure you've seen him around, and the name won't be new to you, but he's been a patron for quite a while and has been somewhat of an unofficial proofreader for some time also. But we got to talking over the last couple of weeks about the lack of progress in the game, and after some back and forth, we were able to identify some issues that were causing the delays, the big one being my own laziness... but we won't talk about that :P Another is simply my lack of motivation to write; this is why I write mini games most of the time, to write something fresh to put me back in the mood for writing the cabin. But after talking for some time, we got onto the discussion of the possibility of him coming on as a writer. At this point, I had about half of the script done, maybe a little less, but he started off with the Roxy introduction scene, and after a couple of days, he came back with a finished story, and although his initial script was good, it needed to be tweaked a bit due to the formal nature he was writing at times. He tweaked it and got it just right. Then he worked on another scene ( 2nd to last ) and that one had far fewer issues. I think 95% of the issues were mostly code issues that I would be doing anyway, like incorrect code names for characters, etc. Then, he worked on the final scene, and let me tell you, it was perfect. Not a single issue, and the story was spot on. I feel like I rambled a little there; long story short, Kingcrab is joining the team as a writer. In theory, this should boost productivity and, in turn, make the release windows shorter. Not to mention, he's already made a start on episode 9 so while I'm chugging away at episode 8, he's going to do episode 9 and so on.

[b]The Expected Release![/b]

I've been working on a rather tricky scene recently, but the art for that is done, and I've made some good progress moving onto the next scene. Every scene from here on out isn't tricky and is pretty straightforward, so I expect nothing but progress in the coming weeks. That being said, you know I don't like giving expected release dates, but I want to try and have it out before the 27th of May. I think it'll be hard, but doable. The only reason I need to have it out by that date is because I'm going on holiday on the 28th and really don't want to worry about not working while I'm away.

notes.title: The Cabin - Episode 7 [ Release... Again ]
notes.notes:
The last couple of days have been a little rough and rather scary. I normally get maybe 3-5 people talking about a release, but for this one, I had probably 30+ telling me how shit the game was, how I fucked everything up, and for me to kill myself, which was honestly a little scary; I'm not going to lie. So, with that happening, I folded and did what they wanted and went to bed. Then I woke up the following morning to even more backlash, hundreds of people telling me how shit the game is, how much they hate me, how I should kill myself, and some threatening to kill themselves, which was even scarier, so I folded once again.

Which brings us to today. After speaking with a good friend, he advised me to just take the day off and not think about any of it. Which I did, well, sort of. I took the day off and watched a few movies, but I couldn't stop thinking about it. I kept checking my phone and seeing the odd message, some good, some really good, and some not so good.

Now, I know I said in the last post about "Fuck it, I'm going to do what I want to do and not let anyone influence me.". But even then, I was still talking shit because at the time, I was still thinking about what people wanted, and I couldn't get out of this mindset of trying to do the impossible task of pleasing everyone. I thought about maybe doing DLCs where the cabin MC could fuck Emi or another Emi game to please those who want Emi, but when it's all said and done, it doesn't matter; I'll never please everyone, and I've had to learn that the hard way.

You wouldn't believe how close I came to just saying fuck it and shutting everything down. I googled how to delete the game on Steam and how to delete a Patreon account, but when it's all said and done, I don't want to do that. I feel like the story has been lost a little, but that's just because people haven't seen what I have planned. I have up to episode 12 plotted out, and I'm really happy with some of the stuff that is coming up, and I know for a fact people are going to go crazy for episode 8!

Which is why I'll leave you with this final message. If you like the game, great, I hope you keep playing and supporting me (and I'm not talking financially; I mean with your kind words of motivation and just your general support. I try to hear everyone's feedback, whether you pay or not). But if you don't like the game, then just don't play it; leave and get on with your life. This shit doesn't need to be that deep. At the end of the day, it should just be an AVN to you and nothing more. I understand that people form attachments; I've got a few myself with some of my favourite games, so I get it, but those attachments should never let you get so angry that you threaten death on yourself or someone else. One of the people who got really angry with me and spammed across multiple platforms sent me a DM and told me how sorry he was and how that isn't the real him and he let his emotions get the better of him, and I really appreciated that apology more than you could know.

... One last message: upon reading through that, I realised I didn't actually tell you what was going on, so here it is. Back in 2022 I did a poll asking people if they wanted to have Emi in the cabin, and people said yes. I realise that I didn't actually specify her as an LI and that poll could have been interpreted as just "She visits, makes up with Hazel, and leaves," but I took it as "Let me fuck her!" And like I said, that was before her game had been released (or maybe it was just after the first game; I haven't checked the dates). Thinking about it now, even though you have the option to say no, it doesn't matter; that thought shouldn't be in her head to begin with, which is why I'm sticking to my original routes of just doing romance games. That's what I've done from the start, and that's what I'll try to continue to do. And like I said, if that upsets you, just don't play. I will be sticking to what I said yesterday about banning people that don't agree with me too. I realise I can't ban people on f95, which is why it's probably a good thing I never go in that thread anymore. I've heard it's been a real shit show in there.

notes.title: The Cabin - Episode 7 [ Release ]
notes.notes:
After reading a lot of comments and complaints about the game, I've decided to do 2 things:

[list]
[*] First, in terms of story, I'm not going to listen to anybody anymore. I've always had the issue of hearing 1-2 people and thinking that's what everyone wants.
[*] 
[*] Second, I'm reverting the game back to how I want it. If you want to fuck Emi, fuck her, and if you don't, then don't. It's on YOU, not me.
[/list]

I've always said I'll never abandon the game, and that still stands true now, but that doesn't mean I want to delete all platforms and work without funding while I do. I know a lot of you have no stake in the game and are happy either way and I want to appologise to those people. If you like the game, then great, play it; if you don't, then just don't play it; it's a fucking AVN; this shit isn't that deep. It's insane to think that I've actually had death threats over this shit and people threatening to kill themselves. If you fuck Emi, it's on YOU!

I'm going to see what the response is from this, and we'll go from there, but just to clarify, I've added Emi back in as a love interest, and if you don't like it, just don't play. And at this point, I'm just going to start banning people from platforms that don't agree with what I'm doing, so if you speak up and chat shit, I'm not going to take it anymore. If you want to reply in a mature manner with actual criticism, that's fine; just don't try and push your will onto me; it won't work anymore.

I'm not going to give an exact date, but expect a release sometime next week, providing nothing fucks up.

I also don't want you to think I've spent the last month or so sitting on my arse waiting for shit to render ( although... mostly I have... ). The script work for episode 7 is finished ( apart from audio and achievements), and the art for the first 3 scenes is being worked on as we speak. I think a release 2 months from the release of episode 6 is possible... but don't quote me :P

And as I said in previous posts, my financial situation at the moment is no bueno, so I've been working on another mini story with Emi; expect that in a couple months too.

I should note, if you have played Emi - New Beginnings and you also play the cabin, you'll need to play the new Emi game before episode 7 of the cabin, as it all ties in.

notes.title: Episode 6 - A little update!
notes.notes:
Hey all.

I wanted to jump back in and provide another brief update, along with a potential release date for episode 6. The script and art have both been finished for a while, and I just finished rendering all the stills ( although going through them, a few fixes are needed ) and I also need to render the animations too.

I was looking to release this month, but with the changes to previous scenes, I don't think that'll be possible, but I do expect a release within the first 2 weeks of next month.

That being said, by the time episode 6 is released, I expect to have the script for episode 7 finished ( I have 2 scenes left to do ) and also have a good chunk of the art done ( I currently have the art for 1 scene finished for episode 7 ).

Yeah, so certainly starting to make some good progress. That being said though, I'm not working alone as I have someone else helping with the art, and I can't thank them enough; they're really helping me get things moving at a much faster pace. But, due to Emi, The Cabin, and AE having been released on Steam for a long time now, funds over here are really starting to dry up, so I think I'll probably take him off working on art for the cabin and get him to work on another small game like Emi ( a really small game ). I just need to do something since I'm at a point where once everything is paid out, I'm really struggling to pay rent and get through the month. But releasing a small game will fix all of that, and since someone else will be working on the art, I don't think it'll slow me down on the cabin and I understand that not everyone is happy with that and it's fine if you don't want to buy another game but I have to do what's best for me and it's something that'll allow me to continue to work. 

One thing I've learned from doing steam is never release a game as early access! Finish the game and then release it! Lesson learned :P

notes.title: The Cabin - Episode 6 Update - Back to work!
notes.notes:
Hey all,


I wanted to start by again thanking everyone for their kind words during this difficult time. It's still pretty rough, but I can't sit around and do nothing anymore; I need to keep my mind active and get back to work, more just so it distracts me than anything else. And for those who don't know (it was posted on patreon but never mentioned here), my dad passed away a couple of weeks ago.

With that being said, I started working back on The Cabin on Friday and made some good progress over the weekend. I got all but 1 scene finished, and the only reason that scene isn't finished is because I'm working with another artist and that scene is currently with him, so I'm just waiting for that. So below is a little list of the current tasks that need to be completed.

[list]
[*] [b]Final scene renders[/b] ( waiting to get them back from the other artist ).
[*] [b]Animations[/b] ( 10 animations total )
[*] [b]Design new GUI[/b] ( main menu and in-game text )
[*] [b]Check plot points[/b] ( Review previous episodes and make sure everything fits )
[*] [b]Rewrite a couple of scenes [/b]( nothing major and no more than a couple days work )
[/list]

Still quite a bit to do, so wouldn't like to give a release date just yet. In terms of that list though, the only thing I won't be working on (apart from the final scene renders) is the animations, as I'm shit at doing them, so I always pay a guy to do them (if you've played AE, then you've seen his work). There are a couple animations I can do myself, like handjobs, but that's pretty much it.

As for the other tasks, designing a new GUI will take a couple days (I will probably do it over a weekend). As I said above, rewriting a couple scenes will only take a couple days as they're really small scenes I want to change, nothing major, but checking plot points will probably be the one that takes the longest time as it means I have to play the game and read through it, and since I hate playing my own work, I expect a lot of tabbing out and watching YouTube videos o.0

That's all the news I have for now. If you have any questions about anything, just post below or DM me, and I'll get back to you asap.

notes.title: The Plotting of The Cabin - Update
notes.notes:
Hey all,

It's been a while since my last report on here, so I had to jump on real quick and let you guys know what's been going on.

As I said last time, I wanted to take March off to plot out the whole game before continuing, and I'm sad to say I failed. I have a decent chunk planned out and am currently plotting out the middle of episode 13. Originally, the game was supposed to be around 10–12 episodes long; it wasn't going to be super long, but since things went so slow between episodes 1–5 with basically no sexual content, I feel I need to keep that pace in order for the sex to make sense. So now, it's looking like the game could be around 20 episodes.

I have slowed down a little with the planning too, just because I got a little burnt out near the end of March, but I'm back at it now and making decent strides again. I hope to have it all finished by the end of the month (or at least have up to 16 done), and once this month's plotting is done, I'm going to start the conversion process for episode 6 next month.

I also tend to get incredibly bored when writing for the same game for a prolonged period of time, and to fix that boredom, I tend to write, which sounds stupid, but I write something that has something to do with what I was writing, soooo I accidentally wrote out another mini game. I know, I know, I'm a bitch, but I wrote it in a weekend; it's about the same size at Adverse Effects, AND it got me back to working on The Cabin and stopped my writers block, so I guess it was a good thing...

The new game is called Nora - Forest Nights, and while I work on the plotting for The Cabin, I'll be working on the art for that. I already have about 25% of the art finished, so it shouldn't take too long to get it done, and I guess you can expect the sales page to be up soon. 

I really appreciate your patience and I know that once we get out of the planning phase and production on episode 6 starts, everything will start flowing much smoother.

notes.title: Work on The Cabin
notes.notes:
Hey all,

I wanted to jump on and let you guys know what's been occurring and what'll be occurring in the coming months.

I'll start by saying that Wizard and I are no longer working together. I'm not going to go into much detail about why, but work from the both of us over the last 6 months to a year just hasn't been as good as it should have been, and I think it'll be better for the game if I continue on my own. I made promises of speedy releases, and over the last 2 months, we have around 300 lines of code and around 40 renders to show for it, which isn't on at all. Wizaed said he had another 700 lines done, but I never saw it, so I can't honestly vouch for it. I have no reason to disbelieve him, but it never made its way into my hands.

So, what does that mean for The Cabin? Well, the first thing I've done is pause Patreon payments ( which wont effect you guys ), and they'll continue to be paused until I make some progress. The second thing I want to do is go back through episodes 1–5 and make notes of any plot points and track all variables so I know what everything does. The third will be to write out a plot for the entire game, something I've wanted to do for a long time but could never get Wiz to agree on. The process of tracking variables, plotting points, and writing a draft of the whole game should take me around a month ( but could move into 2 ), and I hope to have it finished by the end of March. Once that full draft is done, I'll then convert episode 6 into a renpy playable script and work on the art for it, which I hope will take another month, but that process could be as long as 2 months. Once episode 6 is finished and released, I will then convert every other game episode into renpy format and get the whole of the game finished (in terms of script) before starting on the art for episode 7. I want to do that since that'll make releases past episode 7 so much faster.

I know it sounds like a weird way of doing things, but trust me, it's what I did for Nordstrums Treasure, and I loved the process of doing that. I know this'll make the process at The Cabin faster, and I know it'll make me start enjoying working on The Cabin again.

I know this isn't the news anyone wanted to hear, but I feel like it's something I have to do if I want to have any hope of actually finishing The Cabin. I think in 2023 we will release 2-3 episodes, and that's just not enough at all. I'm not saying it's Wizards fault, not at all; I'm to blame for a lot of it too.

Working on Nordstrums Treasure and Adverse Affects has shown me I am capable of doing it alone, and I look forward to what I can do for The Cabin. I feel like a lot of developers in this position would just abandon the game and start fresh under a new name, but I refuse to be one of those developers. Even if it takes me 20 years, The Cabin WILL see a finish! (although I hope it doesn't take 20 years.... 👀)

I'll try to keep you updated over the next couple months with what's going on and how far I've come, and I hope you guys can understand. I also understand if you feel the need to remove your pledge, but Patreon will be paused, so either way, you won't be charged.

notes.title: Progress Report - The Cabin + Future of CellStudios + Emi - Christmas Special
notes.notes:
Hey all,

First off, I hope you're all having a great Christmas or holiday time, and I hope you're all getting some good rest. I've had a great day, spent the first half with the family, and am now back to the grind.

[b]Emi - Christmas Special[/b]
We managed to complete the special in time for Christmas, however, steam was not able to approve the game in time ( probably because we submitted it 3 days before xmas day ) so we're just waiting on them before we can release it. 

[b]The Cabin - Episode 5[/b]

Episode 5 has somewhat been placed on hold for the last couple months. Simply because I was working on the Christmas special and was finding it hard to switch between three projects, something had to give, and since both the Christmas special and WTHI will be the ones paying the rent and heating bill over the next couple months, I had to let episode 5 slip a little.

But fear not, the christmas special is finished so my focus is back on episode 5 and below you'll find a release shedule for 2024 which we're going to try our best to keep up with. 

[b]2023![/b]

As far as I'm concerned, 2023 was a shitshow for us. I think it took over a year to get the rewrite done, which should have only taken 4 months, or 5 maximum. It should have taken us no more than a month to get Emi done; I think that took us around 4 months too. It was nobody's fault why it took as long as it did; just shit kept popping up on my side, and then something would come up on Wiz's side, and we could never seem to get in sync to get shit flowing smoothly.

[b]The Future of CellStudios and 2024![/b]

Going into 2024, you'll be noticing a lot of changes around here. The first change will be to minigames. If we do work on any in 2024, then I want to make sure that Wiz has all the writing 100% done before I look at it. Once he's done that, I'll only work on the art in my spare time and won't let it interfere with working on the cabin. The second change will be to the release schedule of the cabin, or rather, the lack of one. I want to stick to a 2-month release schedule for the cabin going into 2024, which means, if all goes well, we'll have five releases coming out in 2024.

[b]The Cabin Release Shedule:[/b]

As I said above, the cabin took a little pause over the last couple months, so episode 5 isn't too close to being released. I felt like I was close at one point, but I grossly underestimated how big the release was. I'm not going to give too much away, but there is sexy time with two characters in episode 5 and something somewhat sexy with a third. That being said, below is the release schedule for the cabin that we hope to stick to:

[list]
[*] January 2024 - Episode 5 Release
[*] March/May 2024 - Episode 6 Release
[*] July/August 2024 - Episode 7 Release
[*] October/November 2024 - Episode 8 Release
[*] December/Jan 2024/25 - Episode 9 Release
[/list]

That's just a rough schedule for now, and it all depends on the size of the release, but I do plan on making each episode a little shorter than usual just to make sure we can release as much as we can.

( if not of this made sense, it's because it was posted on patreon and is now being reposted here. )

notes.title: The Cabin - Episode 5 News
notes.notes:
Hey all,

I wanted to quickly jump on and share a little update about the progress of episode 5 and where we're at. I normally post updates exclusively to Patreon, but I realised I've been neglecting Steam a little, so going forward, any updates I post on Patreon will also be posted here.

I recently took some time off to clear my head and just experience life a little, but I'm back now, and myself and Wiz have been making progress on episode 5 ( Wiz more so than me :P ). I didn't take as much time off as I planned, but during my time away, I was mostly working on adverse effects in my spare time. I then talked with Wiz about continuing The Cabin, and he started working ahead of me to get some writing done, so once I was done with Adverse Effects, I could jump straight back into the game.

I can now confirm that he has finished writing episode 5, so when I'm finished with adverse effects, I'll be jumping straight into that. Wiz also isn't going to be waiting around for me; he's going to move on and start writing episode 6, and basically he'll keep going with the writing until the game is finished. Then he can sit back and chill while I work on the art.

Speaking of adverse effects, working on it in my spare time was slow going, but it's finally almost finished. I have another 17 renders and 4 animations that need setting up (I should have those finished this weekend), and then I just need to render another 8 or so animations and about another 50 renders. I'm hopeful I'll have everything finished in 2 weeks, and once done, all I have to do is add the animations to the game, add music or SFX, and add the achievements, then just test it all out.

Which means adverse effects should be out in October, and I'll be starting work on episode 5 of the cabin in October too. I talked a little on Patreon about what we'll be doing in the future too in regards to other mini games, but I can't remember if I talked about it here, so I might as well share it here. Going forward, I don't want to work on too many mini games, even though we really need to, because the cabin is at a point now where it's making around $200 a month and both Wiz and myself are doing this full time, so working on a mini game really helps us pay the bills and also stay motivated in the industry.

That being said, mini games can also be a pain since, at least for me, they turn into something way bigger than they were ever intended to be. Adverse effects were only supposed to be around 150–200 renders, but now they're pushing over 700 with around 40 animations. And Norstrum's treasure is looking like it'll be over 2,000 renders when it was supposed to be around 300–500. Which is why, if we do work on another minigame, it'll only happen if Wiz is a decent amount ahead with the writing. If he gets to the point where he is a full episode ahead of me, then he'll be free to write for a mini game while I do the art on the cabin, and then when he's done with that and I've finished the art on the cabin, he'll move on to writing the next episode of the cabin while I do the art on the new mini game.

He's already started plotting out the next minigame, which will be a sequel to Emi. I know a lot of people have been waiting for it, so for those of you that have, rest assured, it's finally happening, and it'll be a little bit larger than the original.

I think I've known you all long enough. I'll stop rambling now and let you get back to enjoying your day or night. I'll do another update post when I have more news.

Thanks,
Cell

notes.title: Status Update - The Cabin, Adverse Effects, Minigames and More!

Hey all,

I wanted to jump back on and give a quick update on what's been going on and what will be going on as we head forward. I made the post public so everyone here and on F95 could see it.

[b]Time Off -[/b]

As you know, I took some time off to rest a little. I took on too many projects and was just feeling really burned out, so I wanted to take a step back and reevaluate everything. I didn't take as much time off as I was expecting, but it was enough for me to feel fresh and ready to get back in the saddle. I've decided to cut down a LOT of my work, which will be explained below. I do still feel like shit, but I think that's just because my mattress is shit. I think a new one might be needed. But the time off helped a lot. I explored a little (nothing massive, just sites around my local area I hadn't seen before), chatted with friends and family, and just spent some time to myself. But it turns out I don't have too many friends and family members, so I got bored pretty quick.

I was still working during my time off, though, mostly on WTHI, Adverse effects, and writing for the cabin.

[b]The Cabin -[/b]

I've done some writing on the cabin while I was away—not much, but I managed to get 14 pages of a word document complete, and that'll turn out to be around 60% of the episode. I wanted to get a draft for the full game written out before actually starting work on episode 5, but I think that might take me around 2 months, and I really don't want to spend that much time just writing, so I'll probably keep doing that but also make a start on episode 5 too. I also plan on changing my work pattern for how I'll be working on the cabin. I used to just work and that was it, never setting up any plans or following a strict guideline for getting the episodes out. That's going to change. I want to have a new episode of The Cabin out every two months.

[b]Adverse Effects -[/b]

I want to get Adverse Effects out before I start on anything else. It's close to being finished; I just need to write the script for the final sex scene, a post-sex scene, and then a bonus scene at the end of the game. I currently have around 300 renders done and will be looking at having around 700 when it's complete. I hope to have it released in September at the latest, but I'm not sure. I've been working on it in my spare time before bed and on the weekends.

[b]Where The Heart Is -[/b]

I'm still working on WTHI; it has always been my main focus, as you know, and that won't change. We're close to getting Episode 24 out, and once that's done, I'm going to spend a week just smashing as much of Adverse Effects as I can to get it done quicker.

[b]Future Minigames -[/b]

I've decided to pause any future minigames, at least for now. Once episode 5 of the cabin is out, I will look at starting up Nordstrum's Treasure again, BUT that game is much bigger than I ever planned it to be, so I probably won't be finishing it anytime soon. I'll probably still do some plots for minigames in my spare time, but for now, I just want to focus on getting Adverse Effects finished and then getting as much of the cabin done as I can.

If you have any questions, feel free to ask below.

Thanks,

Cell.

notes.title: Episode 5 Delays
notes.notes:
I just wanted to jump on real quick and let you guys know about something that's occurred. I've basically spent the last 6 years of my life sitting at the computer all day working on games. I worked on a couple of games before starting my own, which I won't mention by title since I was just the artist on other projects that have since been cancelled.

I went from working on a couple small projects to working on WTHI to starting my own games, and I've loved every minute of it, well, somewhat. Over the last year or so, I've been feeling a little trapped. Since my daily schedule has been to wake up at 10 a.m., go to bed at 11 p.m., and spend my entire day on the computer, I feel like I'm ready for a change.

Please note, though, that this does not mean I'm walking away; I'm not done just yet. I want to spend less time doing this and a little more time having a life, seeing friends, and seeing the world. I know you might be thinking, Why would working on any game stop me from doing those things? and the answer is simply my own mindset. I put the game and working first, and I always have.

That being said, I was at the doctor on Monday as I've been having some pains in my chest, and after having an ECG and getting some blood tests done, it seems I have something going on with my heart and some sort of blood infection. It's nothing to worry about, but it was a little scary and made me step back a little and think about what I want from life.

I'm currently 32, and I have no life—no wife, girlfriend, or kids, and the few friends I have left I barely see anymore. I know people don't like hearing about other people's issues, but that's just the way things are.

I've had a word with Wiz and we've agreed to part ways, maybe we'll join forces again in the future, who knows. For now, I'm going to slowly move forward solo and see what comes of it. I've been working on Adverse Effects solo and loving it.

So what does this mean for the games? Well, I'm going to be taking a month off to just chill and hang out with friends. I tend to get bored a lot, so I'll probably do some writing too, but let me give you a quick breakdown for each project I'm working on:

[b]Where The Heart Is[/b] - I'll still be working on the game as I am now, just working fewer hours. My plan was to step back from it a little, but since it's so close to the end, I figure I can ride it out. ( If you haven't heard about this game, I'd suggest searching for it on Steam and adding it to your wishlist; it's a really good game and one of the OGs.).

[b]The Cabin[/b] - I'll be taking at least a month off from working on the cabin; however, I will be doing some writing for it since I get bored very easily and I like to write. When working on the cabin, I've always worked episode by episode, whereas now, I want to at least plot the entire game out before I continue on episode 5, so I know where it's going. I think to plot the whole game out, it'll probably take me about 2 weeks. I also plan to make it a lot sexier and scarier sooner.

[b]Nordstrums Treasure[/b] - The plot for the game is 100% written out, and around 1,000 lines of script have been made, along with around 90 renders. For now, though, this game is on hold for the foreseeable future.

[b]Adverse Effects[/b] - This one is a tricky one for me to talk about. I've got the plot 100% written out, and around 2,800 lines of script have been made, along with around 250 renders. This was going to be my first finished solo project, and I've really enjoyed making it. I'm very tempted to continue working on it at weekends since I don't want to see it fall and have me forget about it. I have another two stories written out that I really liked, but they never made it to the script phase, which still bums me out, and then I went and got a new SSD and lost the stories for those two ¬.¬

I really hope resting, getting out, and seeing the world will help me recharge my batteries. But something I can say for sure is that every game above will one day be finished! We've all seen far too many games get abandoned, and I won't go down that route; my pride won't allow it.

I'll make another announcement sometime in August about what's been going on and if things are going well.

As always though, we're not going to give an expected release date just yet, once we're closer to having things done we will do but for now, enjoy some previews :P

Just wanted to thank everyone for their patience with episode 2.

We had a slightly rocky start with achievements not working and a couple graphical issues but both have been fixed now.

Sadly we're unable to fix old saves not working, we believe it's because we added achievements to episode 1 but we're not 100% sure as we're unable to pin point the exact cause.

I also said in a smaller update that the game has 425+ new renders, this isn't true, I missed a folder and it's actually more like 590+ new renders.

notes.title: Developement Update - Episode 2 | #3
notes.notes:
Hey all,

First off, Merry Christmas/Happy Holidays. I hope you all got the socks and deodorant you didn't want ¬.¬

Just wanted to jump on real quick and give an update on episode 2 of the rewrite and also what to expect from episode 3 and 4. ( Pretty sure I've told you guys about episode 3/4 before but I can't remember :P )

So, we originally wanted to get episode 2 out before christmas but sadly that isn't going to happen. The writing is finished but I still have a little more art to do. Now you might be thinking "Art? But this is a rewrite, why is there new art?" Well, it's because we've removed a few scenes and added in a few new ones.

I still have around 16 renders to do ( which I'll get done today ) and 1 scene to render ( which I'll render tonight ) and then all we need to do is check for any missing images/render fixes that might need doing, add sounds/music and add achievements. So I think it's safe to say we'll for sure be done before the new year.

As for episode 3 and 4, like I've said in the past ( or I think I have :P ), episode 3 won't take long at all because we've no plans to add any new major scenes. The only real change that'll be happening that we currently have planned is Apurna will be removed and we'll likely be adding a new date in for Kaydence. And episode 4 was wrote by Wizard++ so that one won't need a rewrite, it'll just be updated with new references to tie in with the new stuff in episodes 1-3.

I can also give you a rough estimate for what episode 2 consists of:

[list]
[*] Around 20,000 words
[*] Around 450 renders.
[/list]

We don't have an accurate count yet as we're still adding little things in and touching areas up but that's a rough idea what to expect.

notes.title: The Cabin - Episode 2 News
notes.notes:
Hey, just wanted to thank everyone who has purshased the game already and those who have it in their wishlist.

We had a bit of a rocky start, we planned to release once episode 1-5 was rewrote but due to some personal issues we had to release a little early. On top of that I decided to make a smaller side game to see how well they do on steam and to see if smaller stories are something people might be interested in. That game is currently under review by steam and hopefully will be released in a few days.

But now that the smaller game is finished, my focus is 100% back on the cabin so I wanted to jump on and let you know where we're at and what to expect going forward.

The art for episode 2 is 80% complete. It was 100% but since the writer is doing a rewrite of the whole thing we decided to add in a couple of additional scenes to fill in some spaces where we had a massive time gap.

The writing for episode 2 is about 30% done. Might not seem like much but the writing was working on the 2nd mini game as well ( he turned my piece of crap kinetic game into an actual game with choices and different outcomes :P ) also he is a super fast writer so I have full faith in him.

I don't want to give an estimate for a release just yet but we're thinking either end of this month or start/middle of next month. I know Wizard++ is a fast writer but I'm putting the release date that far ahead just to be on the safe side.

Some of you also may have noticed that episode 1-4 is available on our patreon account. This is an older version of the game though and a lot of that will be changed so I wouldn't bother trying it.

I'll also be keeping you updated a lot more. My sole focus this last couple months has been on Emi to get that out and finished. Now that it's done, I'll be focused a lot more on The Cabin.
